use_when: A user-initiated action that resolves on the page it is on — submit, confirm, cancel, toggle a mode, open a dialog.
dont_use_when: Navigating to another URL: this renders a native <button> with no href, so it is invisible to a middle-click, a bookmark, and a crawler — use an anchor. Showing an arrow or glyph on its own: use IconSlot. A second Primary in the same view: demote it to Secondary, because Primary means the one thing this view wants you to do.
placement: Forms, cards, dialogs, toolbars, and the call to action closing a page section.
a11y: Native <button>, so it is in the tab order and Enter and Space activate it. Focus is visible on all three variants: :focus-visible replaces the shadow with effect.focus-ring. State=Disabled sets the native disabled attribute, which both announces it as unavailable and removes it from the tab order; State=Loading disables it too and adds aria-busy. The trailing arrow is aria-hidden — the label carries the meaning. Target size is per-size and not equal: Md is 36px tall from its tokens (13.5/16.2 type plus 10px padding), which clears WCAG 2.5.8 AA at 24x24 and misses 2.5.5 AAA at 44x44; Lg is 47px and clears both. Choose Lg where a 44px target is required. The loading spinner stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
